headline: Little Acorn Fund budget, closing of the Passport Office, and a proposed full-time Programing Librarian position.
summary: The meeting covers the Little Acorn Fund budget and a proposal for a full-time Programing Librarian position. It also covers closing the Passport Office, closing Saturday December 26, 2026, and the 2027 library holidays and trustee meeting schedule.
